competing_explanation: The return policy may have changed, or standard items may be subject to a different window or exclusion that alters the stated 30-day full-refund period.
hypothesis_statement: The current full-refund return window for standard items is 30 days.
refutation_criterion: Policy evidence shows the current standard-item full-refund window is not 30 days, such as 14 days, 60 days, or a materially different condition-based window.
